description: This file defines the structures and logic for evaluating execution approval commands within the OpenClaw project. It includes data models such as ExecApprovalEvaluation, and an evaluator class ExecApprovalEvaluator with methods to assess command approval based on security policies, allowlists, and trusted skill bins.

classes.name: ExecApprovalEvaluation
classes.description: Data structure holding the evaluation details of an approval command, such as command strings, security settings, allowlists, and approval results.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates a command for approval, considering security policies, allowlists, environment, and trust levels, returning an ExecApprovalEvaluation instance.

methods.name: isSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Determines if the command resolutions are within trusted skill bins based on predefined trust mappings.

methods.name: _testIsSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Internal test method to verify the logic of skill auto-allowance based on provided resolutions and trust mappings.
